verdict.rationale: Khoj documents Automations that run a saved query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency and email the results. This is a time-based trigger with one fixed action, not general event-driven rules. missing for 10: triggers on non-time events (e.g., file changes, new notes, incoming messages), user-defined conditional rules, configurable action types beyond emailing research, in-depth docs and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automations allow you run your query automatically at a scheduled time and frequency. Khoj will send its research to you as an email.
